## Walkthrough

`Operator.Config` now delegates Telemeter token loading to an ordered helper that checks the primary and global pull secrets, stops after finding a token, and aggregates failures into one warning. `Config.LoadToken` parses provided Docker-config secrets directly. Tests cover primary, fallback, empty-token, and missing-secret cases.
